value.rationale: The model is a natural published two-grating moving optical medium, and the exact perturbative threshold quantifies a physically relevant trapping-speed band. It distinguishes the effect of adding a faster co-propagating grating from adding a stationary or oppositely moving one, with a universal sign switch across integer velocity ratios, while retaining an exact projective restriction on possible phase locking. The two-edge classification is structurally informative beyond checking a single numerical operating point.
